name: Don Robertson
story: Don Robertson and Mary de Winton described the Freshwater Biodata Information System, FBIS, as a web-based system joining records for fish, invertebrates, submerged macrophytes and other freshwater biota, some of them extending back decades. Users could search by organism, sampling attributes or location, and a web map allowed sites to be selected geographically. Their 2004 article includes a screen image showing how users accessed the records.

sources.label: Don Robertson and Mary de Winton, FBIS: a new freshwater biodata information system, 1 September 2004
